calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_key) as unique_members_contacted,
       COUNT(*) as total_contacts
FROM fact_campaign_exposure
WHERE campaign_id = 19

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT fce.member_key) as members_contacted,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) as total_spending
FROM fact_campaign_exposure fce
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line fsl 
  ON fce.member_key = fsl.member_key 
  AND fsl.sale_date >= '2026-05-04' 
  AND fsl.sale_date <= '2026-05-24'
WHERE fce.campaign_id = 19

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT fce.member_key) as members_contacted,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fsl.net_amount IS NOT NULL THEN fce.member_key END) as members_with_sales,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) as total_spending_net_amount,
  SUM(fsl.gross_amount) as total_spending_gross_amount
FROM fact_campaign_exposure fce
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line fsl 
  ON fce.member_key = fsl.member_key 
  AND fsl.sale_date >= '2026-05-04' 
  AND fsl.sale_date <= '2026-05-24'
WHERE fce.campaign_id = 19

SELECT 
  MIN(fsl.sale_date) as first_sale_date,
  MAX(fsl.sale_date) as last_sale_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.sales_line_id) as sales_line_count,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) as total_net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN fact_campaign_exposure fce 
  ON fsl.member_key = fce.member_key 
WHERE fce.campaign_id = 19
  AND fsl.sale_date >= '2026-05-04' 
  AND fsl.sale_date <= '2026-05-24'
